title: 旧布包摊开口
summary: In the rented room at night, under the one table lamp, an old cloth bag lies with its mouth opened — the cloth washed pale, one drawstring frayed through.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the rented room at night, small and narrow; the desk stands across the far side of frame under the window, and on it one table lamp lights a small pool of the desktop; 苏小满 (S1) sits at the near side of the desk, turned three-quarters to camera with her back to the door, her face toward the lamp and the desktop; a single bed and a rolled quilt lie along the west wall at the left of frame; beyond the window at the far end lies the black of night.
[Shot 1] Close, high angle onto the desk: in the lamp's small pool of light an old cloth bag lies with its mouth opened, the cloth washed pale and one of its drawstrings frayed through.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.600, medium: 苏小满 (S1) leans over the desk, her face and shoulders in the upper two-thirds of frame, the opened bag and the desktop in the lower part.
soundscape: The table lamp's soft electric hum, the fabric of the old bag rustling under her hands, the faint creak of the desk, and the small sounds of a narrow room at night.

title: 摊出一张泛黄的照片
summary: From the bag a photograph is tipped out flat on the desktop — old and yellowed, all four corners curled, every edge worn from handling.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) leans over the desk with the opened old cloth bag in front of her under the lamp, her back to the door.
[Shot 1] Close on the desk: from the bag a photograph is tipped out and spread flat on the desktop — the paper is old and yellowed, all four corners curled, each edge worn from being handled; the lamp's light comes down on it from above.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.800, medium: her two hands lie on either side of the photograph without touching it yet; her face is lowered into the lamp's light above it, and the window sits far beyond her at the end of the depth.
soundscape: The photograph sliding out of the cloth, the bag's frayed drawstring ticking on the desk, the lamp's electric hum, and the still night beyond the window.

title: 年轻女人抱着婴儿
summary: The photograph shows a young woman standing by the river with a baby in the crook of her left arm, her face to the lens in a shy smile, a wisp of hair lifted by the river wind.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the yellowed photograph lies flat on the desk under the lamp with 苏小满's (S1) hands on either side of it, and she leans over it with her back to the door.
[Shot 1] Close to near: the camera pushes in on the photograph itself — a young woman stands by the river holding a baby in the crook of her left arm, her face to the lens with a shy smile, a wisp of hair lifted by the river wind; a little water-stain and a spot of mould mark one corner of the print.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, medium: back to 苏小满 (S1) leaning over the shot, her hands flat on the desk on either side of the photograph, her shadow falling short on the wood.
soundscape: The lamp's steady hum, her slow breath over the desktop, the tiny creak of the desk as she leans, and the quiet night at the window.

title: 身后的桥与那个桥墩
summary: Behind the woman in the photograph stands the great bridge, and at its foot that same old, unusual pier — identical to the framed photograph on the veranda wall.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) leans over the desk and looks down at the yellowed photograph of the young woman and the baby.
[Shot 1] Close on the photograph's background: behind the woman stands the great bridge, and at the foot of the bridge that same old, unusual pier — the identical one to the framed photograph on the veranda wall.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, near: her face above the photograph in the lamp's light, her eyes travelling from the woman to the bridge behind her; the two old pictures, one from the day and one from tonight, have met across twenty-two years.
soundscape: The lamp's low hum, her breath catching once over the desk, the faint tick of the desk wood, and the night holding still beyond the window.

title: 把照片翻过来
summary: Two fingers take the edge of the print and turn it over; the back of the paper is yellower and thinner than the front.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) leans over the desk, the photograph lying face-up under the lamp in front of her.
[Shot 1] Close on the desk: 苏小满's (S1) two fingers take the edge of the photograph and turn it over; the back of the print is yellower and thinner than the front.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.800, medium: the photograph now lies face-down on the desk under the lamp, her face lowered over it in the upper two-thirds of frame, the back of the print in the lower part.
soundscape: The old paper turning over on the desk, her fingers brushing the print, the lamp's electric hum, and the small creak of the chair as she leans in.

title: 背面褪色的字
summary: On the back of the print a line of faded handwriting runs low across the paper, small and faint and worn, and her fingertip comes to rest above the first strokes without daring to touch.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the photograph lies face-down on the desk under the lamp with 苏小满 (S1) leaning over it.
[Shot 1] Close on the back of the photograph: a line of faded handwriting runs low across the paper, small and faint, its strokes barely darker than the paper beneath — a line of faded handwriting on the back of the photograph, unreadable.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.600, nearest: her fingertip comes to rest above the first strokes of the line and stops there, not daring to touch, as if the ink would scatter at a stroke; the upper two-thirds of frame hold the pale line of writing and the back of the print, the lower part her two fingers pinching the edge of the photograph.
soundscape: The lamp's steady hum, one slow breath above the desk, the faint flex of the old paper, and the quiet night at the window.

title: 凑到台灯下
summary: She bends lower, lifts the photograph in both hands and brings it up into the lamp's pool of light, close enough to feel the heat of the bulb, and looks for a long time.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) leans over the desk with the photograph face-down before her and her fingertip resting above the faded line of writing.
[Shot 1] Medium: 苏小满 (S1) bends lower at the desk, back to the door and three-quarters to camera, lifts the photograph in both hands and brings it up into the lamp's small pool of light, close enough to feel the heat of the bulb.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.200, near to close, the lamp's light on her face: the warm light comes up from below and rims her jaw, the bridge of her nose and the short red cord at her collar; she looks for a long time, long enough that the camera itself stops moving, and beyond her at the window lies the night.
soundscape: The lamp's warm hum close to her face, the paper held steady in both hands, the chair easing under her, and the low night beyond the window.

title: 妈，你去过哪
summary: Her eyes still dry, she asks very low, as if not to disturb the person in the photograph, her lips moving once before the word comes.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the photograph up in the lamp's light, her face lowered over it, her back to the door.
[Shot 1] Close on 苏小满's (S1) face in the lamp light: she does not cry and her eyes stay dry; she asks very low, as if not to disturb the person in the photograph, and her lips move once before the word comes: [Chinese] 妈，你去过哪。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, near: her eyes on the laughing young woman in the print, her gaze drifting a little out of focus, the warm light lying along her cheek while the little room beyond her stays soft and readable.
soundscape: A very low young voice close over the photograph, the lamp's steady hum, the chair's small creak, and the quiet night at the window.

title: 你救过谁
summary: The second question comes even lower and slower; she lifts the photograph half an inch nearer the lamp as if the answer might come clearer, and her lower lip presses once.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the photograph in the lamp's light with her dry eyes on it.
[Shot 1] Close on 苏小满's (S1) face: the second question comes even lower and slower, and she lifts the photograph half an inch nearer to the lamp, as if the answer might come clearer: [Chinese] 你救过谁。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, near: on the last words her lower lip presses once, and then she says nothing more for a long while while the lamp's small current hums in the room.
soundscape: A second question even lower than the first, the lamp's small current hum, the old paper held steady, and the night resting beyond the window.

title: 亮着的只有一张照片和一张脸
summary: The lamp's warm soft pool holds one old photograph and one face, and the little room stays softly readable all around them; she never answers the questions she has just put.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the photograph up in the lamp's light with her face lowered over it, having asked her two questions and got no answer.
[Shot 1] Medium: the lamp's warm soft pool holds one old photograph and one face, and the little room stays softly readable all around them, every corner still open and detailed rather than falling to black.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.600, close: the photograph lies in the soft warm pool of lamplight on the table top with her hand still under it, and she never answers the questions she has just put to it herself.
soundscape: The table lamp's steady hum, the old cloth bag shifting against the table top, the far tick of the building settling, and the low night beyond the window.
music: A low string entry, settling low.
